name: Mind
overview: Scripture reveals the mind as a vital battleground where believers are called to focus their thoughts on God's precepts and ways, cultivating a mind stayed on Him to experience perfect peace (Psalms 119:15; Isaiah 26:3). The Christian life involves a transformation through the renewing of the mind, rejecting conformity to worldly patterns and embracing the Spirit's influence to discern God's good and perfect will (Romans 12:2; Romans 8:5). Believers are urged to embody the mindset of Christ Jesus, offering themselves as living sacrifices in reasonable service to God (Philippians 2:5; Romans 12:1).
